mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shopwizard.tCatCate WHERE SvcCode = #{svcCode} AND CateCode = #{cateCode}

SELECT tCatCate1.CateCode AS CateCode1, tCatCate1.CateName AS CateName1, tCatCate2.CateCode AS CateCode2, tCatCate2.CateName AS CateName2, tCatCate3.CateCode AS CateCode3, tCatCate3.CateName AS CateName3, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode AS CateCode4, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateName AS CateName4, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateName FROM shopwizard.tCatCate INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCatCate tCatCate1 ON SUBSTRING(tCatCate1.CateCode,1,4) = SUBSTRING(shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode,1,4) AND tCatCate1.CateLevel = 0 AND tCatCate1.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCatCate tCatCate2 ON SUBSTRING(tCatCate2.CateCode,1,7) = SUBSTRING(shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode,1,7) AND tCatCate2.CateLevel = 1 AND tCatCate2.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCatCate tCatCate3 ON SUBSTRING(tCatCate3.CateCode,1,10) = SUBSTRING(shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode,1,10) AND tCatCate3.CateLevel = 2 AND tCatCate3.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} WHERE shopwizard.tCatCate.CateLevel = 3 AND shopwizard.tCatCate.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} AND (shopwizard.tCatCate.CateName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCateName},'%') OR tCatCate1.CateName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCateName},'%') OR tCatCate2.CateName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCateName},'%') OR tCatCate3.CateName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCateName},'%')) UNION ALL SELECT tCatCate1.CateCode AS CateCode1, tCatCate1.CateName AS CateName1, tCatCate2.CateCode AS CateCode2, tCatCate2.CateName AS CateName2, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode AS CateCode3, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateName AS CateName3, '' AS CateCode4, '' AS CateName4, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateName FROM shopwizard.tCatCate INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCatCate tCatCate1 ON SUBSTRING(tCatCate1.CateCode,1,4) = SUBSTRING(shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode,1,4) AND tCatCate1.CateLevel = 0 AND tCatCate1.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCatCate tCatCate2 ON SUBSTRING(tCatCate2.CateCode,1,7) = SUBSTRING(shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode,1,7) AND tCatCate2.CateLevel = 1 AND tCatCate2.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} WHERE shopwizard.tCatCate.CateLevel = 2 AND shopwizard.tCatCate.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} AND (shopwizard.tCatCate.CateName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCateName},'%') OR tCatCate1.CateName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCateName},'%') OR tCatCate2.CateName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCateName},'%')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT CateCode FROM shopwizard.tCatCate C WHERE C.ParentCateCode = shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode AND C.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode}) UNION ALL SELECT tCatCate1.CateCode AS CateCode1, tCatCate1.CateName AS CateName1, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode AS CateCode2, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateName AS CateName2, '' AS CateCode3, '' AS CateName3, '' AS CateCode4, '' AS CateName4, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode, shopwizard.tCatCate.CateName FROM shopwizard.tCatCate INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCatCate tCatCate1 ON SUBSTRING(tCatCate1.CateCode,1,4) = SUBSTRING(shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode,1,4) AND tCatCate1.CateLevel = 0 AND tCatCate1.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} WHERE shopwizard.tCatCate.CateLevel = 1 AND shopwizard.tCatCate.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} AND (shopwizard.tCatCate.CateName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCateName},'%') OR tCatCate1.CateName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCateName},'%')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT CateCode FROM shopwizard.tCatCate C WHERE C.ParentCateCode = shopwizard.tCatCate.CateCode AND C.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tCatCate WHERE SvcCode = #{svcCode} AND CateCode = #{cateCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tCatCate WHERE SvcCode = #{svcCode} AND ParentCateCode = #{parentCateCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tCatCate ( SvcCode, CateCode, CateName, CateDesc, ParentCateCode, CateLevel, CateSeq, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate, ChangeId, ChangeName, ChangeDate ) VALUES ( #{svcCode}, #{cateCode}, #{cateName}, #{cateDesc}, #{parentCateCode}, #{cateLevel}, #{cateSeq}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW(), #{changeId}, #{changeName}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tCatCate SET CateName = #{cateName}, CateDesc = #{cateDesc}, CateSeq = #{cateSeq}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE SvcCode = #{svcCode} AND CateCode = #{cateCode}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopwizard.tCatCate WHERE SvcCode = #{svcCode} AND CateCode = #{cateCode}
